qualification: Boot-time modern virtio block PCI resource discovery

checks.host: madmax Intel Linux, accessed through puck.local

observations: Root validated modern virtio block identity at 00:05.0 and reported 4096-byte common, notification and device-config spans at physical addresses 0xfe000000, 0xfe003000 and 0xfe002000.
The required discovery marker is emitted only after verifying BAR/command restoration and deleting the temporary PCI configuration-port capability.
The Intel run also completed Linux ring3 initramfs syscalls and the bidirectional console exchange with the new PCI device present.
limitations: No block device MMIO or DMA mapping is granted to an Intel driver yet, and this test does not complete a block request through the Intel device.
The board selects a fixed PCI function; enumeration of arbitrary bridges or hotplug devices is not implemented.
Host fixtures exercise malformed capability layouts and BAR bounds. Hardware I/O errors and failed BAR restoration were not injected.
The test medium is a disposable qualification fixture, not the pinned Debian baseline or writable persistence evidence.
Canonical integration, GUI qualification and the v0.4 release remain incomplete.
